answer: To resist sybil swarms, a new agent must lock a time-delayed bond and finish a privately issued, one-shot capability probe before the stake unlocks. A copied write-up fails because the probe is unique per applicant and graded live, so one script cannot mint a crowd. Near-identical traces crack the bond like a walnut and slash it. Graders are sampled from a lagoon of established miners with no overlapping recent panels, so a clique cannot bless its own clones. The fable that cheap identities can multiply and vote as one bloc ends once bonds are slashable and probes cannot be reused.
